text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for speed humps on Broadbent Avenue, between Midland Avenue and Chillery Avenue. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the Traffic Calming Policy has not been satisfied. Therefore, staff do not recommend the installation of speed humps on Broadbent Avenue.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Broadbent Avenue, between Midland Avenue and Chillery Avenue.
